title: Hangar Safety Plan
description: Free Hangar Safety Plan template for aviation you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, daily hangar checks, emergency response.
html:
REF: AHG-______ REVISION: 01 DATE: ____/____/________

DOCUMENT DETAILS
AIRPORT / HANGAR: ______________OPERATOR / MRO: ______________
HANGAR MANAGER: ______________PLAN DATE: ______________
AIRCRAFT TYPES: ______________REVIEW DATE: ______________

Hazards And Controls

HazardControl measure
Fire (fuel, solvents, hot work)Hot work permit, fire suppression, extinguishers, fuel handling rules, no smoking
Aircraft movement and towingTow plan, wing walkers, chocks, communication, speed limit
Falls from height (wings, tail, docks)Docks and stands, fall arrest, edge protection
Hazardous materials (fuel, hydraulic fluid, solvents)SDS, labelled storage, spill kits, ventilation
Engine runs and noiseRun-up procedure, hearing protection, exhaust extraction
Electrical, compressed air and ground powerInspection, lock-out, cable management
Foreign object damage (FOD)FOD walks, tool control, housekeeping

Daily Hangar Checks

☐ Fire detection, suppression systems and extinguishers in service

☐ Fuel, chemical and paint stores compliant

☐ Floors clean and free of oil, FOD and trip hazards

☐ Tow equipment and ground support equipment inspected

☐ Aircraft jacks, stands and docks inspected and tagged

☐ Emergency exits and eyewash stations clear

☐ Tool control and calibration records up to date

Emergency Response

EventInitial action
Fuel spillStop work, isolate ignition, contain and clean, report
FireRaise alarm, activate suppression, evacuate, call fire service
Personal injuryFirst aid, call emergency number, protect the scene

Approval & Sign-Off

RoleNameSignatureDate

legislation and site procedures.
